userStories.title: Standardize config validation to use ValueError for out-of-range values
acceptanceCriteria: MatchingConfig.__post_init__ raises ValueError instead of silently clamping for clearly invalid values (e.g., negative confidence thresholds)
EmbeddingConfig.__post_init__ raises ValueError instead of silently clamping for clearly invalid values
Add a docstring comment block in src/config/base.py documenting the validation convention: ValueError for invalid types/impossible values, warn+clamp for soft limits
Write test verifying MatchingConfig raises ValueError for negative confidence_threshold
Write test verifying EmbeddingConfig raises ValueError for negative dimensions
userStories.notes: Tier: MEDIUM. DONE: MatchingConfig raises ValueError for negative confidence thresholds and non-positive integer fields (embedding_candidates, etc). EmbeddingConfig raises ValueError for negative batch_size, max_retries, retry_delay, and max_workers. Values > 1.0 for confidence are warn+clamped. Validation convention docstring added to base.py. 19 new tests added to test_config_section_validation.py.
